Three regressions from round-2 coalescing:
(A) services/optimize/fileImageService.js claims optimizeReport.recountQueuedAt.File.<type> (repositories/optimizeReportRepository.js claimOptimizedImagesRecount, 15-min TTL) and dispatches the recursive action `count_optimized_images`. That action is handled in handlers/cron/subscribeRecursive.js (case RECURSIVE_COUNT_OPTIMIZED_IMAGES, ~L740-805, self-chaining with lastDocId) — it never clears the marker. The only clear is in services/optimize/recountOptimizedImages.js, which runs only on the Cloud Run finalize path. Result: after the first manual completion every later completion for 15 min is suppressed and the trailing recount the code promises never happens → Report card counts stay stale. Fix: in that case, on the FIRST page only (lastDocId null/absent), clear the marker for that source/type via updateOptimizeReport(shop.id, {recountQueuedAt: {[source]: {[type]: null}}}) BEFORE counting (merge-set; check updateOptimizeReport merges). Keep the recountOptimizedImages clear.
(B) services/audit/scheduleStoreRecompute.js: when dispatchWork rejects, the .catch only logs and the marker stays → every write for 10 min queues nothing and that recompute is lost. Fix: clear the marker (clearStoreRecompute) in that catch.
(C) The RECURSIVE_RECOMPUTE_STORE_CHECKLIST case in subscribeRecursive.js (~L214) passes the dispatched `shop` payload (snapshot from the writer, possibly minutes old) to applyStoreResourcesResult, which uses shop.issueFixed for convertDataIssue and recalcChecklistScore → dismissals made since then get reopened. Fix: reload the shop (getShopById from the module subscribeRecursive already uses for shops, or @avada/core getShopById — check which this file uses) after clearing the marker and pass the fresh shop.
Tests: handlers/cron/__tests__/subscribeRecursive.recountMarker.test.js (first page clears marker before count; later pages don't), handlers/cron/__tests__/subscribeRecursive.recompute.test.js (fresh shop passed), services/audit/__tests__/scheduleStoreRecompute.test.js (dispatch failure clears marker). Mock like handlers/cron/__tests__/subscribeRecursive.chainFork.test.js.
